name: Fantasy Date
source: An anime character dating simulator. Explore meaningful relationships through conversations, earn points by answering questions correctly, and unlock romantic moments. Fulfill your fantasies, delve into intimate experiences, and create unforgettable memories. Take your date to a more special level as you deepen your connection. Ready to embark on romantic adventures with your favorite anime characters?
